definition.preoperative_baseline: last same-analyte troponin within 30 days before OR entry
definition.postoperative_window: OR exit through 72 hours or hospital discharge, whichever occurred first
definition.with_baseline: postoperative peak > assay URL and postoperative peak - baseline >= 1 postoperative assay URL
definition.without_baseline: at least 2 postoperative same-analyte measurements, peak > URL, and maximum-minimum >= 1 peak assay URL
definition.MOVER_URL: row-specific cTnI upper reference limit after ng/L unit harmonization
definition.INSPIRE_URL: cTnI 0.04 micrograms/L (40 ng/L); cTnT 0.014 micrograms/L (14 ng/L)
definition.final_MACE: laboratory-defined acute myocardial injury proxy OR documented MI, cardiac arrest, or stroke
definition.interpretation: laboratory proxy; not adjudicated MINS or PMI
